description: This file is a shell script that contains tests related to optional configuration paths in a Git-like environment. It uses an external library 'test-lib.sh' and defines several test cases to verify behavior when optional configuration values are present or missing.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets up or tests configuration values, possibly in a Git repository context.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines test cases expected to succeed if the condition holds.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines test cases expected to fail, used to verify error conditions.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in output or a file.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Creates cleanup actions to run after tests.
